questionText: [Set 35.1] The dietary approach recommended in clinical nutrition for managing hypertension (DASH diet) emphasizes:

options.text: High potassium, calcium, magnesium, and dietary fiber with restricted sodium intake
High saturated animal fats and refined table sugar with zero dietary fiber
High sodium chloride intake with complete restriction of green vegetables
Exclusive consumption of red processed meats without water

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics - Therapeutic Diet for Hypertension (DASH Diet)):
The DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) diet emphasizes fruits, vegetables, whole grains, poultry, fish, and nuts, reducing sodium, red meats, sweets, and saturated fats to lower blood pressure.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

solution.concept: Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics: Therapeutic Diet for Hypertension (DASH Diet)
solution.detailed:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics - Therapeutic Diet for Hypertension (DASH Diet)):
The DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) diet emphasizes fruits, vegetables, whole grains, poultry, fish, and nuts, reducing sodium, red meats, sweets, and saturated fats to lower blood pressure.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

keyConcept: Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics: Therapeutic Diet for Hypertension (DASH Diet)

questionText: [Set 35.2] In pediatric clinical assessment, Kwashiorkor is clinically distinguished from Marasmus by the prominent presence of:

options.text: Severe muscle wasting and subcutaneous fat depletion without oedema (skin and bone appearance)
Oedema (fluid accumulation in legs and face) and enlarged fatty liver with adequate calorie intake but acute protein deficiency
Vitamin C scurvy bleeding gums exclusively
Excessive subcutaneous adipose tissue and childhood obesity

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Public Nutrition and Health - Nutritional Deficiency: Kwashiorkor vs Marasmus):
Kwashiorkor is caused by acute protein deficiency despite sufficient caloric intake, leading to generalized oedema, enlarged fatty liver, lethargy, and a 'moon face'. Marasmus is total protein-energy malnutrition characterized by severe wasting without oedema.

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.

solution.concept: Public Nutrition and Health: Nutritional Deficiency: Kwashiorkor vs Marasmus
solution.detailed:
Detailed Solution:

questionText: [Set 35.3] In industrial dairy technology, High-Temperature Short-Time (HTST) pasteurization of milk involves heating milk to:

options.text: 71.7°C (approx 72°C) for at least 15 seconds, followed by rapid cooling to below 4°C
100°C for two hours under boiling pressure
63°C for fifteen seconds followed by storage at room temperature
140°C for twenty minutes continuously

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Food Processing and Technology - Pasteurization of Milk (HTST Method)):
HTST pasteurization heats milk to $71.7^\circ\text{C}$ ($161^\circ\text{F}$) for 15 seconds, which destroys pathogenic vegetative microorganisms (e.g., Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Coxiella burnetii) without impairing milk flavor.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

questionText: [Set 35.4] According to Jean Piaget's stages of cognitive development, children aged 2 to 7 years in the 'Preoperational Stage' exhibit:

options.text: Egocentrism, animism, and lack of conservation (inability to understand that quantity remains invariant despite perceptual changes)
Abstract propositional logic and hypothetico-deductive reasoning
Mastery of reversible mathematical conservation operations
Coordination of sensory motor reflexes with zero symbolic language

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Early Childhood Care and Education - Piaget's Preoperational Cognitive Stage):
In Piaget's preoperational stage (2-7 years), symbolic play and language expand rapidly, but children's thinking remains egocentric (inability to see others' perspectives) and lacks conservation of volume, mass, and number.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

chapter: Care and Maintenance of Fabrics in Institutions
questionText: [Set 35.5] When removing protein-based stains (such as blood or egg) from fabrics, one should strictly avoid using hot water because:

options.text: Hot water bleaches synthetic dyes instantly
Hot water coagulates the protein, setting the stain permanently into the fabric fibers
Protein stains dissolve only in boiling concentrated sulphuric acid
Hot water transforms the protein into insoluble cellulose wax

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Care and Maintenance of Fabrics in Institutions - Stain Removal: Protein Stains):
Protein coagulates when heated. Washing blood or egg stains with hot water 'cooks' the protein into the yarns, fixing it permanently. Protein stains must always be treated first with cold or lukewarm water and mild enzymatic detergent.

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.

Agricultural food products and commodities (such as ghee, honey, butter, and spices)

topic: Elements of Design: Optical Illusion Lines
questionText: [Set 35.7] In apparel design, using prominent vertical lines in a garment visually creates the optical impression of:

options.text: Increased width and a shorter, broader appearance
Increased height and a slimmer, elongated silhouette
Unequal asymmetrical body distortion
Rotating circular motion

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Design for Fabric and Apparel - Elements of Design: Optical Illusion Lines):
Vertical lines lead the viewer's eye up and down, creating an illusion of added height and slender proportions. Horizontal lines draw the eye across, emphasizing width.

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.

questionText: [Set 35.8] A key defining characteristic of 'Community Radio' stations in rural development communication is that they:

options.text: Broadcast high-cost commercial advertisements for foreign multinational corporations
Operate nationwide high-power satellite relays across all Indian states
Are owned, managed, and programmed by and for the local community to address local grassroots issues in local dialects
Are owned exclusively by private commercial media conglomerates

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Development Communication and Journalism - Community Radio Features):
Community radio is a third tier of radio broadcasting (alongside public and commercial radio). It is low-power, non-profit, operated by local community groups or educational institutions, broadcasting content relevant to local farming, health, and development needs.

Hence, Option (C) is the correct answer.

questionText: [Set 35.29] When removing protein-based stains (such as blood or egg) from fabrics, one should strictly avoid using hot water because:

options.text: Hot water bleaches synthetic dyes instantly
Hot water coagulates the protein, setting the stain permanently into the fabric fibers
Protein stains dissolve only in boiling concentrated sulphuric acid
Hot water transforms the protein into insoluble cellulose wax

detailedSolution:

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.

options.text: Increased width and a shorter, broader appearance

Increased height and a slimmer, elongated silhouette
Rotating circular motion

detailedSolution:

questionText: [Set 35.48] A key defining characteristic of 'Community Radio' stations in rural development communication is that they:

options.text: Are owned, managed, and programmed by and for the local community to address local grassroots issues in local dialects
Broadcast high-cost commercial advertisements for foreign multinational corporations
Operate nationwide high-power satellite relays across all Indian states
Are owned exclusively by private commercial media conglomerates

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Development Communication and Journalism - Community Radio Features):
Community radio is a third tier of radio broadcasting (alongside public and commercial radio). It is low-power, non-profit, operated by local community groups or educational institutions, broadcasting content relevant to local farming, health, and development needs.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

questionText: [Set 35.49] The dietary approach recommended in clinical nutrition for managing hypertension (DASH diet) emphasizes:

options.text: High saturated animal fats and refined table sugar with zero dietary fiber
High potassium, calcium, magnesium, and dietary fiber with restricted sodium intake
High sodium chloride intake with complete restriction of green vegetables
Exclusive consumption of red processed meats without water

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics - Therapeutic Diet for Hypertension (DASH Diet)):
The DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) diet emphasizes fruits, vegetables, whole grains, poultry, fish, and nuts, reducing sodium, red meats, sweets, and saturated fats to lower blood pressure.

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.

questionText: [Set 35.50] In pediatric clinical assessment, Kwashiorkor is clinically distinguished from Marasmus by the prominent presence of:

options.text: Severe muscle wasting and subcutaneous fat depletion without oedema (skin and bone appearance)
Vitamin C scurvy bleeding gums exclusively
Excessive subcutaneous adipose tissue and childhood obesity
Oedema (fluid accumulation in legs and face) and enlarged fatty liver with adequate calorie intake but acute protein deficiency

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Public Nutrition and Health - Nutritional Deficiency: Kwashiorkor vs Marasmus):
Kwashiorkor is caused by acute protein deficiency despite sufficient caloric intake, leading to generalized oedema, enlarged fatty liver, lethargy, and a 'moon face'. Marasmus is total protein-energy malnutrition characterized by severe wasting without oedema.

Hence, Option (D) is the correct answer.
